$comment: Circuits (tours) covered by the app. Add a tour by appending an entry — nothing in the model/API logic hardcodes these ids.

history.$comment: How much history to ingest by default and where the raw CSVs live. `startYear` is the earliest season pulled by `npm run update-data` (override with --from). Serve/break stats exist in Sackmann data from ~1991 onward. `mirrors` lists alternative GitHub repos to git-clone if the primary one is unreachable from your network.
history.rawBaseUrlsComment: Tried in order. jsDelivr is a CDN that mirrors GitHub file-by-file and is usually reachable on networks that filter raw.githubusercontent.com — it still serves the ORIGINAL repo, so the data is current.
